identity: Mournfen's barrows hold the oldest remembered dead of the Throng; the fen keeps rising, bandits loot the barrows and the mirefolk count stolen bones as wages.

quests.title: Boars in the Burial Rows
quests.text: Rooting Plague Boars dig through the {name:blightfields} {zone_area:blightfields} by day and turn up what the fen had politely covered. Put down eight of them. Something else is digging too, and it leaves tally marks; we will come to that.
quests.lesson: New band, familiar neutral boars; the fen's local problem is seeded.

quests.title: Tallow for the Vigil
quests.text: Bring me eight Raw Meat. I render it down for the vigil candles; the mourners in Mournfen would rather sit in the dark than admit the candles smell of boar, but they sit by them all the same.
quests.lesson: Ordinary loot can be saved before the request is accepted.

quests.title: Word for the Outpost
quests.text: Take what you have seen to Sera Vane at Mournfen Outpost. She watches the reed beds, and she has been finding the same tally marks I have.
quests.lesson: Travel to the zone's second hub.

quests.title: Wages Paid in Bones
quests.text: The Reed Mirefolk of {name:blackreed_enclosure}, {dir_from_giver:blackreed_enclosure}, pay each other in barrow bones and scratch every payment on a reed. The one who keeps the big tally is called Silt. Thin out eight of them; mind the Reed Crocodiles that lie about the enclosure.
quests.lesson: A mirefolk camp with a crocodile minor role; the line's climax is seeded.

quests.title: Lights in the Wispfen
quests.text: After dark Wandering Wisps drift over the {name:wispfen} {zone_area:wispfen} and lead the mourners into the water. Put out seven of them. By day the same ground belongs to the Plague Tuskers, which are a different kind of problem.
quests.lesson: A night-only target over swamp ground.

quests.title: Tusks in the Barrowfields
quests.text: Plague Tuskers have taken the {name:barrowfields} {zone_area:barrowfields} by day and they charge anyone who comes to tend the barrows. Kill seven. Cairn Sun-Dried Husks shuffle among them; you will meet those whether you want to or not.
quests.lesson: Aggressive boars with a slow undead minor role.

quests.title: Iron for the Lantern Hooks
quests.text: Mine and smelt six Iron Bars and bring four Coal Lumps besides. The lantern hooks along the barrow paths rusted through, and a lantern lying in the mud guides nobody.
quests.lesson: Mining and smelting stay independent of professions.

quests.title: Motes for the Long Candles
quests.text: The Wandering Wisps in the {name:wispfen} leave Wisp Motes behind. Bring me three; a pinch in the wax and a vigil candle burns all night without anyone getting up to trim it.
quests.lesson: A night drop request that shares the wisp outing.

quests.title: The Unclaimed at the Cairns
quests.text: Pauper Shamblers climb out of the {name:cairns} {dir_of:mournfen_village:cairns} at night. Nobody claimed them in life and nobody claims them now, which is exactly why they will not lie still. Lay six of them down; I will write their numbers in the book, since we have no names.
quests.lesson: A night hunt on high ground near the top of the band.

quests.title: Lookouts over the Barrows
quests.text: The bandits who sell barrow goods to the mirefolk hold the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}. Their Bandit Lookouts shoot first; get in close and drop six of them. They have a prisoner up there, Hollis Grey, and I would like him back talking.
quests.lesson: Ranged humanoids: close the distance or use cover.

quests.title: A Prisoner Who Kept Count
quests.text: The lookouts are thinned. Go into the {name:bandit_camp} and speak with Hollis Grey; he spent weeks watching where the bandits carried their sacks.
quests.lesson: Travel to a captive inside a hostile camp.

quests.title: Silt's Final Tally
quests.text: Every sack went to the {name:mire_nests} {dir_from_giver:mire_nests}, where {name:reed_counter_silt} counts the bones and pays the bandits in pearls. Kill five Reed Mirefolk there and end Silt's count; without the tally the whole trade falls apart.
quests.lesson: The line's climax: a named normal leader at its camp.

quests.title: Nhal Veyr Must Hear It
quests.text: I am getting out of this camp, and you are going to Nhal Veyr. Tell Ossa Quietregister in the Vigil Hall what Silt was buying; the capital keeps the register of the dead, and the register has gaps now.

quests.title: Repeatable: Gnawers in the Barrowfields
quests.text: Grave Gnawers burrow into the {name:barrowfields} {zone_area:barrowfields} every night. Kill six and come back; I post this again twenty minutes after you hand it in.

quests.title: Repeatable: Deepfen Lights
quests.text: Wandering Wisps gather over the {name:deepfen} {zone_area:deepfen} after dark. Put out six and report; the watch posts this again twenty-five minutes after you hand it in.
quests.lesson: Optional repeatable hunting contract at the top of the band.
